params.body:
## Why

Reviewing UI work behind a feature flag means a second code path in production that has to be removed after the review, and reviewing on the test box means made-up data. The owner decided on 2026-09-16: one extra Forge site on the production server, `preview.traders.stocklistdealer.eu`, `APP_ENV=preview`, database `forge_preview` as a nightly copy of production. A pull request is put on it on demand, the owner and the dealer team look at their own data in the new version, then the pull request is merged. One at a time.

## What

- **`bin/preview <pr-number|branch>`** (standalone PHP, like the other `bin/` scripts): resolves the head branch with `gh pr view` (read-only), points the Forge site at that branch (`PUT sites/{site}/git`), deploys (`POST deployment/deploy`), polls `deployment-history` until the run is finished, prints the address and the PR title. `--status` prints branch, state and last deployment. Refuses a merged PR and a site that is already deploying. On a failed deploy the last forty lines of Forge's deployment output are printed (exit 2). Server and site id come from `.forge-preview.json` (git-ignored; `.forge-preview.example.json` committed) or `FORGE_PREVIEW_SERVER`/`FORGE_PREVIEW_SITE`; the token from `FORGE_API_TOKEN` or `~/.config/hub-report/forge-api-token`, never printed.
- **`stocklist:preview-refresh`**: two `mysqldump --single-transaction --quick` passes from the `production_source` connection (`PREVIEW_SOURCE_DB_*`, all nullable, documented in `.env.example`) piped into `mysql` on the preview database: the structure of every table, then the rows of every table except `telescope_*`, `jobs`, `jobs_delayed`, `failed_jobs`, `sessions`, `cache`, `cache_locks`, `api_log` and the `*_copy` leftovers. Then `migrate --force` (a PR with a migration works) and the timestamp to `storage/app/preview-data-at`. Three locks before a byte moves: `APP_ENV=preview`, `Outbound::allowed()` false, source is not the target. Passwords go through the environment (`MYSQL_PWD` per side of the pipe under `bash -o pipefail`), never on argv. Scheduled `dailyAt('04:00')->environments(['preview'])->withoutOverlapping(120)`.
- **Environment bar** (`layouts/omgevingsbalk.blade.php`): on `preview` it says "PREVIEW, PR 488, abc1234, data van 16/09 04:00" (commas and spaces, no middle dots) from `App\Support\Preview`: branch and commit from the checkout (commit through `BuildStamp`, the same source as `/.well-known/build.json`), the PR number when the branch name carries it (`pr-488`, `workbench/pr-488`), otherwise the branch name; "nog geen kopie van de data" before the first refresh. The demo reset button is not shown on the preview. `data-environment` attribute added for tests. Not a hot file.
- **Docs**: `docs/preview.md` (Dutch: what it is, the one-time Forge checklist, `bin/preview 488`, what the bar says, the nightly copy, limits), one line in `CUTOVER.md`, rules P3-7.9 and P3-7.10 in `33-p3-integraties.md`.
- **Tests**: `PreviewEnvironmentTest` (9 tests): sealed on `preview`; bar label with a fake checkout and stamp; branch without PR number; unchanged outside preview; refresh refuses in `testing` and `production` with exit 1 and a clear message, refuses a missing source and a source equal to the target; schedule pinned (`0 4 * * *`, environments `['preview']`, overlap lock); `commandLine()` pinned (single transaction, ignore-tables only on the rows pass, passwords not in argv or in the shell line).

## What the owner does once

See `docs/preview.md`: create the database `forge_preview`, a read-only MySQL user on production (`SELECT, SHOW VIEW, LOCK TABLES, TRIGGER, EVENT`), the Forge site with the same deploy script and quick deploy off, the scheduler, the `.env` (`APP_ENV=preview`, `APP_URL`, `DB_DATABASE=forge_preview`, `SESSION_COOKIE=sl_preview_session`, `PREVIEW_SOURCE_DB_*`, no `OUTBOUND_*`), run `stocklist:preview-refresh` once, put a Forge API token in `~/.config/hub-report/forge-api-token` and fill in `.forge-preview.json`.

## Tests run

`PreviewEnvironmentTest`, `ScheduleTest`, `OutboundTest`, `CompiledViewsTest`, `RulesCoverageTest`, `RulesIdentityTest`, `RulesDocsBuildTest`, `SmokeTest` (261), `AlpineExpressionTest`, `HandlerWiringTest`, `StylesheetSyntaxTest`, `ClassReferencesResolveTest`, `IntegrationSmokeTest`: all green on a database built from `database/schema/mysql-schema.sql` plus the migrations after 2026-07-28. `BuildStampTest` 404s in a git worktree on origin/main as well (refs live in the common dir); untouched here.
params.title: A preview site for looking at a pull request with real data before it merges
